reason: The plugin is primarily a session/context usage analytics utility: it focuses on reading DSH session logs and producing per-session and project-level context-cost metrics, rather than generating code or controlling workflows. This maps to data-processing because its main user value is metric extraction, aggregation, and reporting from local logs.

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DSH 会话上下文统计面板，可读取本地会话日志并输出每会话消息、轮次、工具调用与预估 token 统计，以及全局与按项目的上下文报告。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DSH context usage dashboard that reads local session logs and outputs per-session metrics (messages, turns, tool calls, estimated tokens) along with global and per-project context reports.

capabilities: Read and parse local DeepSeek Harness session logs in `.jsonl` and `.jsonl.zstd` formats
Generate per-session metrics such as message counts, turns, tool calls, character counts, and estimated tokens
Produce aggregate context usage reports, including global totals and per-project summaries

reasons.code: Session analytics and reporting are explicit plugin functions exposed via `session_stats` and `context_report`.
Plugin purpose and scope is limited to context usage statistics for DSH sessions, with no declared external service integration.
